environment.description: Same container on ECS Fargate. ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:111122223333:regional/webacl/prod-api-acl/a1b2c3d4) with three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) Priority 0 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to Count, (2) Priority 1 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with NO action overrides (all rules in BLOCK mode including SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS, SQLi_BODY, SQLi_COOKIE, SQLi_URIPATH), (3) Priority 2 - custom rate-based rule 2000 req/5min per source IP. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that routes /api/keys/* to a separate target group requiring mTLS client certificate validation via the ALB's trust store (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:111122223333:truststore/internal-ca-store/ts-0abc123def456). The container's security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group.
